_comment: Vanilla's glow lichen under a tint of ours, laid flat in the top of the water block, until the asset
**`light_emission` is fixed and the block's own light level is not**, and that split is the whole
point of it. The mat is drawn at full brightness whatever the hour, so a lake reads as red specks in
a black cavern at midnight -- spider eyes, not a lamp -- while what it actually *radiates* follows
`AlgaeBlock.glowAtHour` and leaves the water around it genuinely dark. One is what you can see, the
other is what you can see *by*.
It is vanilla's own idiom: `block/cross_emissive`, which the firefly bush and the open eyeblossom
wear. Theirs lays an emissive overlay over part of a texture; ours has no separate overlay to lay,
